name: hira_gooface
desc: Keep the same melted, dripping paint body, size and pose. The head is pushing out of the goo: the long horse face with wide-open leering eyes and a huge toothy grin, the mouth stretched open with thick sticky paint strings between the upper and lower teeth, the spiky mane only half formed and drooping, still half melted, with thick sticky paint stretching and stringing from the face, the chin and the mouth, gooey and gross. The legs stay a thick melted mass merged into the puddle. Same colors, cream swirls, outline and pixel art style.
